name: gatsby
description_en: React-based framework with performance, scalability, and security built in.
readme_excerpt: Gatsby The future of web development is here. Gatsby is a free and open-source framework based on React that helps developers build blazing fast websites and apps. It combines the control and scalability of dynamically rendered sites with the speed of static-site generation, creating a whole new web of possibilities.
